steps.content: You follow the music through the Abyss, walking through an endless void until you lose track of time.
When you finally stop, you see it: a piano not far away. An ordinary piano, the kind you'd imagine when you hear its sound.
But the melody... it feels so familiar, so dear. You would never forget the tune, even if your consciousness were reduced to dust.
You want to take a step closer, to see who's playing, but your feet refuse to move. As if humans can only come this far, and no further.
But the pianist senses your presence. The music stops. He looks up, toward you.
A pure white silhouette. A... person you cannot discern.

steps.speaker: White Figure
steps.content: ...Why are you here? I told you I would stay. You don't need to come looking...
He stops. He gazes in your direction for a long while.

steps.speaker: White Figure
steps.content: ...I mistook you for someone else. I thought you were ■■.

steps.speaker: White Figure
steps.content: Are you lost?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I want to go back, but...
You open your mouth, but no sound comes out. Your body trembles as a force presses on your throat. It isn't from this void, but from within you...

You watch as every vein in your body swells and burns red, your boiling blood growling like a wild thing trying to burst free. You watch as your skin stretches taut, cells crisscrossing into frigid blue grids, every triangle cold and precise, sealing everything like a coffin.
You never knew such terrifying forces dwelled within you. What chills you to the bone is how they're tearing you apart, pulling you in two different directions, and you can't control either one.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...How do I go back?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Back... to where?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: After going back... what will I become?
The figure watches you being ripped apart. He says nothing, doesn't move. After a long moment, he turns impassively back to the piano keys, like he's contemplating what to play next.

steps.speaker: White Figure
steps.content: ...Who knows? That's your problem.
He raises his hands.

steps.speaker: White Figure
steps.content: You have to find your own answers.
[Sound effect, followed by faint red light effect]

He presses a black key. A jolt runs through your body as your heart starts pounding forcefully in your chest, drowning out the roaring in your blood. It beats steady and fierce, the heat gathering in your palms before pulsing back through your veins, rejoining your circulation.
Next, he presses a white key.
[Sound effect, followed by faint blue light effect]

The ice coating your skin melts away, the patterns receding toward your head. The terror subsides, and you realize there's nothing here to fear. Clarity returns to your thoughts, forming your name, coalescing into your swaying earring.
You look up at him again. Through his ethereal white glow, you glimpse a smile, strange, yet somehow familiar.

steps.speaker: White Figure
steps.content: Don't be afraid. They've always been a part of you. Learn to use them, then find your own way.

steps.speaker: White Figure
steps.content: Find the answers yourself. No one can make your choices for you.
The man bows his head; the question seems to require a great deal of thought. You can hear the space around you beginning to crack.
Red and blue seep into the pure white domain, breaking it apart. The piano and the man, the only things untouched, drift farther away. He seems to give up on his thoughts and smiles at you.

steps.speaker: White Figure
steps.content: ...I suppose it's time to go back. It was good to see you, ${PlayerName}.
The next moment, countless rays of light burst from the cracks, engulfing the piano and the man who helped you.
The pure white illusion shatters, and time resumes its course. You leave the rift, returning to the flow of time.
